letter.subject: Application: Access Engineer, V/Line, Marc Masarate
paragraphs: I am applying for the Access Engineer role that V/Line listed on SEEK (job 95255981). Your advert says rail experience is welcome but not essential, and asks for transferable knowledge from engineering, construction or project work. Reviewing proposed works, checking them against safety and operational requirements and keeping accurate permit records is the kind of work my background points to.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I reviewed structural and architectural drawings, checked work against project requirements, carried out site inspections and safety checks, and escalated issues that needed corrective action. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I prepared site reports, material records and progress reports, and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services and site constraints. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019) and use Microsoft Office. I have not worked in rail or on an Australian site yet, so access applications and Site Access Permits would be new to me.
I live in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport for travel across the network, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
I've attached my resume and cover letter. I would be glad to talk about the role.
